question: IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter
help_text: Tax-exempt status is foundational; must be current. Reinstatements require extra bond counsel diligence.
lead_time: Already in hand (6-18 mo if new entity)

question: Articles of Incorporation & Bylaws
help_text: Must be current, reflecting all amendments. Governance gaps add extra bond counsel hours.

question: Board authorization resolution
help_text: Specific to the bond transaction; cannot be pre-approved generically.

question: Management structure chart
help_text: Key personnel, reporting lines, affiliated entities.

question: Certificate of Good Standing
help_text: Must be current within 60-90 days of closing. State-dependent processing time.

question: All affiliate/subsidiary organizational docs
help_text: Required if affiliate is obligated group member or has pledged assets.

question: Management agreement (if external manager)
help_text: Subordination provisions critical for lender protection. Management structures raise OS disclosure complexity.

question: Existing debt schedule & bond documents
help_text: Every outstanding bond must be reviewed for cross-covenant compliance.

question: List of all pending litigation
help_text: Must include all claims > materiality threshold (typically $1M or 1% of revenue).

question: Insurance certificates
help_text: General liability, property, professional liability (malpractice), D&O.

question: HIPAA compliance attestation
help_text: Required by some bond counsel; always noted in Risk Factors.

question: State hospital operating license
help_text: Annual renewal; must be current through projected closing date. Lapsed license = deal collapse.

question: Medicare Certification (CMS-855)
help_text: Medicare revenue is typically >40% of hospital revenue. Termination proceedings must be disclosed.

question: Medicaid Provider Agreement
help_text: Must be in good standing in all states where billing occurs.

question: Joint Commission Accreditation (or DNV/HFAP equivalent)
help_text: Many lenders require JCAHO; unaccredited hospitals face rating agency scrutiny.

question: Certificate of Need (CON)
help_text: Required only in CON states (~35 states); varies by project type. Early identification is critical.

question: CMS Cost Report (most recent)
help_text: Bond counsel and feasibility consultant will review.

question: State Health Department inspection reports
help_text: Deficiencies must be disclosed.

question: DEA registration (if applicable)
help_text: Required for controlled substance programs.

question: CLIA certification (lab)
help_text: Required if hospital operates clinical lab.

question: Radiation program licenses
help_text: NRC or state, depending on facility.

question: Audited financial statements (3 most recent FYs)
help_text: Dated financials create rating agency concern; deal can stall. If FY audit is in progress, timeline risk is significant.
lead_time: Already in hand if audit complete; 90-180 days if waiting

question: Interim financial statements (YTD, within 60-90 days)
help_text: Underwriter and rating agencies require current picture.

question: Management's Discussion & Analysis (MD&A)
help_text: Key narrative connecting numbers to strategy.

question: 5-year financial projections
help_text: Must align with feasibility study if one is required. Weak projections = more feasibility study work = higher fees.

question: Payor mix analysis (by revenue source)
help_text: Medicare %, Medicaid %, commercial, self-pay; trend over 3 years.

question: Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement trend analysis
help_text: Required in OS; rating agencies scrutinize payment reform exposure.

question: Accounts receivable aging & days outstanding
help_text: Indicator of billing efficiency.

question: Days cash on hand (DCOH) calculation
help_text: Below 100 DCOH raises significant questions. Rating agencies set thresholds; investment-grade typically requires 150+ DCOH.

question: Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) — historical
help_text: Historical DSCR below 1.25x = rating pressure = higher fees. Must be calculated on existing AND pro-forma basis.

question: Operating margin trend (3 years)
help_text: Negative or declining trend requires narrative explanation.

question: Capital expenditure history and plan
help_text: Bond proceeds source-and-uses alignment.

question: Debt-to-capitalization ratio
help_text: Leverage indicator; compares to sector benchmarks.

question: Existing rate covenant compliance
help_text: If existing covenants have been breached (or are at risk), deal is complicated. Waiver process = extra bond counsel + existing bondholder negotiations.

question: Average daily census (ADC) — 3-year trend
help_text: Core utilization metric; disclosed in OS.

question: Occupancy rates (inpatient, ICU) — 3-year trend
help_text: Volume indicator.

question: Case mix index (CMI) — 3-year trend
help_text: Acuity and revenue intensity indicator.

question: Outpatient visit volumes — 3-year trend
help_text: Outpatient shift narrative is required.

question: Surgical case volume — 3-year trend
help_text: High-margin services; supports revenue projections.

question: Emergency department visits — 3-year trend
help_text: Volume and capacity indicator.

question: Medical staff composition (FTE physicians, employed vs. independent)
help_text: Physician enterprise stability is a rating factor. Turnover or alignment issues must be disclosed.

question: Staffing levels and turnover (nursing, key clinical)
help_text: Post-COVID; agency/travel nurse cost exposure is disclosed.

question: Quality metrics (mortality, readmissions, HAI rates)
help_text: Comparative benchmarks; reputational and regulatory risk signals.

question: Feasibility study (independent consultant)
help_text: Required for most new money deals; may be waived on refinancing-only. Cost is $40K-$120K+; scope is driven by data quality provided.

question: Project cost estimate (independent cost estimator or contractor)
help_text: Must match sources & uses in OS. Underestimated project costs = budget overruns = bondholder concern.

question: Architect/engineer contract and plans
help_text: Required at appropriate design stage (typically schematic at bond issuance).
lead_time: Already underway or 4-12 months if early stage

question: Construction contract (GMP or fixed-price preferred)
help_text: Open-ended contracts require additional disclosure and contingency. GMP preferred.

question: Site control documentation (title, lease, easements)
help_text: Must demonstrate clear site control before closing.

question: Environmental assessment — Phase I ESA
help_text: Early Phase I prevents surprise delays. Phase II (if triggered) adds 3-6 months.

question: Environmental assessment — Phase II ESA (if triggered)
help_text: Required only if Phase I identifies recognized environmental conditions. Deal delays, remediation costs, title insurance complications.

question: Appraisal of mortgaged property
help_text: Required if mortgage security; must meet FIRREA standards.

question: Title insurance commitment
help_text: Required for mortgage security deals.

question: Zoning compliance letter / entitlements
help_text: Zoning issues trigger OS risk factor disclosures and possible deal restructuring.

question: Certificate of Occupancy (existing facilities)
help_text: Must be current and consistent with licensed use.

question: Master facility plan
help_text: Provides strategic context for capital project.

question: Equipment list and specifications (if equipment-heavy project)
help_text: Affects sources & uses allocation.

question: IRS Form 990 (3 most recent years)
help_text: Public document; bond counsel reviews for consistency with financial disclosures.

question: Property tax exemption documentation
help_text: Required where hospital claims exemption; challenges must be disclosed.

question: Sales tax exemption certificate
help_text: Relevant for capital project purchasing.

question: Federal arbitrage compliance certifications (if refunding)
help_text: Complex arbitrage issues add bond counsel fees.

question: Prior bond tax compliance records (rebate, yield reduction)
help_text: Prior non-compliance is a significant issue.

question: 501(c)(3) conflict of interest policy
help_text: IRS governance standard; bond counsel may request.

question: Executive compensation documentation
help_text: Unusual compensation structures disclosed in OS. Pull from 990, board minutes.

question: Rating agency presentation package
help_text: Most impactful single item for deal economics. Poorly prepared presentations = lower initial rating = higher interest cost.

question: Prior rating agency reports & outstanding surveillance items
help_text: Unresolved surveillance flags = additional rating agency work.

question: Strategic plan (3-5 year)
help_text: Required for rating narrative; key for feasibility study consistency. Must align with financial projections.

question: Market share analysis (by service line and geography)
help_text: Rating agencies assess competitive position. Feasibility consultant will prepare but hospital data needed.

question: Physician recruitment plan
help_text: Supports volume projections; required for growing programs.

question: Community benefit documentation
help_text: Relevant for community relations; sometimes cited in OS narrative.
